chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Huzyefa ibn Mansur, who said:
I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: 'The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to apply lime paste to the pubic area and what is beneath the kidneys, every Friday.'

key_terms.الْأَلْيَتَيْنِ: The kidneys or the region beneath them (lower back/flanks)
key_terms.يَطْلِي: He used to apply/cover with a paste (specifically lime paste for hair removal)

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad do regarding hair removal on Fridays?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the Prophet Muhammad’s (SAWW) consistent practice of applying lime paste (noura) to the pubic area and flanks every Friday, emphasizing the importance of regular grooming as part of ritual purity (taharah). In Shia scholarly tradition, this weekly routine is viewed as a prophetic model for maintaining cleanliness and preparing for the communal Friday prayer, reflecting the holistic nature of Islamic hygiene.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin sinan, from Huzyefa Bin Mansour who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> used to wax the unwanted hairs, and what is beneath the kidneys, during every Friday’.
en.sarwar: 14. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur who has said the following: “

I once heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, would apply lime paste to the pubic region and under the rump every Friday.’”
